title: FedSAP: Federated Learning with Structured Adaptive Partitioning for Multi-Domain Heterogeneous Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2610.01638v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) on heterogeneous edge devices must jointly accommodate unequal resource budgets and domain-shifted local data. Existing resource-adaptive methods decide how much of a model each client trains but not where retained capacity should reside or how it should be shared, whereas federated domain-generalization methods usually assume a shared full architecture. Uniform compression can therefore discard high-utility channels, and a single aggregation path can mix transferable features with domain-sensitive updates. We propose FedSAP, a domain-aware heterogeneous FL framework that casts structured pruning as budget-constrained tri-state channel allocation. FedSAP converts each keep ratio into non-uniform layer budgets, assigns stable channels to a Global pool, useful domain-sensitive channels to pseudo-domain-specific Private pools, and low-utility channels to a Dropped state. translated_title: FedSAP：面向多域异构边缘设备的结构化自适应分区联邦学习
translated_abstract: 异构边缘设备上的联邦学习（FL）必须同时应对不均等的资源预算和存在域偏移的本地数据。现有的资源自适应方法仅决定每个客户端训练模型的多少部分，却不决定保留的容量应置于何处以及如何共享；而联邦域泛化方法通常假设所有客户端共享完整的模型架构。因此，均匀压缩可能会丢弃高效用的通道，而单一的聚合路径可能会将可迁移特征与域敏感更新混杂在一起。我们提出FedSAP，一个域感知的异构联邦学习框架，它将结构化剪枝问题转化为预算约束下的三态通道分配问题。FedSAP将每个保留率转换为非均匀的层间预算，把稳定通道分配给全局池，将有用的域敏感通道分配给伪域特定的私有池，并将低效用通道置于丢弃状态。这种划分使得广泛有用的特征能够……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FedSAP提出了一种域感知的异构联邦学习框架，将结构化剪枝建模为预算约束下的三态通道分配（全局池、私有池、丢弃），从而在资源不均等且数据存在域偏移的边缘设备上，实现容量按需保留与可迁移特征和域敏感特征的分离共享。
en_tdlr: FedSAP is a domain-aware heterogeneous federated learning framework that casts structured pruning as budget-constrained tri-state channel allocation (Global, Private, and Dropped pools), enabling edge devices with unequal resources and domain-shifted data to retain capacity where it matters and share transferable features separately from domain-sensitive updates.
